title: B2B contacts count under California privacy

beats.say: Penny asks: do business contacts count under California's privacy law? Archie starts: it depends...
Not today. The employee and B2B exemptions expired at the end of 2022.
beats.speaker: archie

beats.say: So classic CRM data, employees and business contacts, is in scope.
Archie looks almost sad. No 'it depends' today.

facts.claim: The temporary CCPA exemptions for employee and business-to-business data expired on December 31, 2022.
facts.evidence: The temporary exemptions for employee and business-to-business data expired on December 31, 2022

facts.claim: Personal information about employees and B2B contacts, typical CRM data, is now in scope.
facts.evidence: personal information about employees and B2B contacts, typical CRM data, is now in scope
